title: Odd symmetrization preserves tester parameters
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a randomized sign tester on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $ eta,[0m\varepsilon,\delta, B\in\mathbb{R}$ with $0\leq\delta\leq1$. Suppose every coordinate dictator is accepted by $T$ with probability at least $\beta$, and every odd function $f$ valued in $[-1,1]$ whose stable influences at parameter $1-\delta$ are all at most $\varepsilon$ is accepted with probability at most $B$. Then every coordinate dictator is accepted by the odd-symmetrized tester with probability at least $\beta$, and every $[-1,1]$-valued function whose stable influences at parameter $1-\delta$ are all at most $\varepsilon$ is accepted by the odd-symmetrized tester with probability at most $B$.
